3. `<span aria-label="was $140">` on price-was — also prohibited on generic span. Replaced with a `.visually-hidden` "was " prefix span so the accessible text reads naturally.

- `landmark-one-main` / `page-has-heading-one` — `<main id="main">` and a single `<h1>` are present in markup; flagged only because jsdom can't compute visibility.
- `color-contrast` on `.skip-link` — gold (`#e8c27a`) on dark ink (`#1a1408`) ≈ 11:1, well above AA.
